have been with this practice for over 30 years, as have my family.

We have now left this practice due to the unprofessionalism of their business manager.

This man is the rudest person I have ever dealt with in my life and the doctors make excuses for his behaviour.  Misogynistic behaviour doesn’t even cover it!

He works at a GP surgery & yet he has zero lack of empathy and doesn’t understand the need for it in his position at a GP practice when speaking with patients.

He throws PERSONAL insults and insinuates abhorrent suggestions and spoke to me like I was trash.   He left me in tears.

From the very outset of a call he was unprofessional, rude, and aggressive.

I will admit I unconsciously raised my voice in frustration and pain due to stress, (a lot of which has been caused in the past week due to this practice)  but from the first word out of his mouth his tone was blunt, rude and dismissive, as well consciously provoking.

This practice failed to inform an elderly member of my family THREE TIMES on THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS, regarding test results of concern, for nearly 2 months, meaning the medication they were taking could cause further damage that was unnecessary and could be avoided.

This was only noticed and communicated to the patient after I had contacted the surgery on a separate issue relating to them!

If I hadn’t it would have continued to be missed and they would still be on the wrong dose of medication.

I made a complaint about how this was missed and handled, and that they failed in their duty of care to protect an elderly person.

They have also been assessed in the past and again in 2024 by their quality care commission and told they lack adequate capability in relaying test results to patients, and that this needs improvement.  Seems that fell on deaf ears.

When I then chased my own issue up, that they had been dealing with for a week, which had a deadline that they were aware of, for some reason HE called me back, and not the receptionist I spoke with.

From the outset of the call he was extremely rude, talking over the top of me repeating himself loudly, therefore not allowing me to speak and explain properly, and his attitude escalated to him throwing personal insulting accusations at me claiming I was using a family members issue for my own personal gain.

It was crystal clear due to my complaint the week prior, that when it came to an issue with my own health, the VALID complaint tainted his attitude towards me.

The man should not be working somewhere where people are asking for help due to health.

If it were my practice I would instantly dismiss him for the way he spoke to a patient.  But the Drs don’t care either and blame the patient entirely.

Even if the patient is in their opinion aggressive, which in my opinion I wasn’t, as a professional they do NOT have the right to throw PERSONAL insults about the patients character.

They have the right to end the call, NOT speak to a patient like dirt and purposely provoke them.
